assertion.statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism, the geometric stalk of a higher direct image is the cohomology of the base change to the strict henselization.
assertion.objects: Generic-point inclusion j:Spec(K)->Spec(O_K[1/2]) and the finite discrete G_K-module M=T/2^aT.
assertion.hypotheses: K is a number field; a is positive; use finite coefficients first. The generic-point inclusion is affine, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated.
assertion.quantifiers: Each finite coefficient precision and every geometric point at a finite place outside2.
assertion.parameter_range: Etale sheaves on the indicated schemes and continuous cohomology of the associated discrete modules.
assertion.uniformity: Natural maps at every precision; no assertion commuting an unchecked inverse limit.
assertion.constants: No degree denominator or rationalization.
assertion.normalizations: The edge map is restriction to strict-local geometric stalks. At a closed place the strict-local generic field has inertia as absolute Galois group after choosing an extension of the place.
assertion.exceptional_cases: This does not require the representation or a later field extension to be unramified. It does not itself prove corestriction compatibility or inverse-limit existence.
assertion.limit_order: Establish the finite-coefficient injection and inertia kernel first; take the compatible inverse limit only through the separately retained definition of Kato integral cohomology.

use.reason: Primitive source theorem used in the explicit finite-coefficient Leray/inertia argument.
